verdict.rationale: Make publishes an extensive REST API reference (resources like connections, data-stores, analytics, audit-logs, AI-agents), OAuth 2.0 authentication flows, a TypeScript SDK, and a dedicated MCP server that exposes scenarios/management as AI-callable tools — directly enabling AI-native/API-driven usage. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (probe found 404s) and independent third-party corroboration beyond vendor docs.
